items.title: Show HN: A Karpathy-style LLM wiki your agents maintain (Markdown and Git)
items.title_zh: Show HN：由 Agent 维护的 Karpathy 式 LLM Wiki（Markdown + Git）
items.summary: wuphf is an LLM-native wiki that agents both read from and write into, using Markdown and Git as the source of truth with a BM25 plus SQLite index. Each agent gets a private notebook alongside a shared team wiki, and entries move through a draft-to-wiki promotion flow.

items.title: LEGO: An LLM Skill-Based Front-End Design Generation Platform
items.title_zh: LEGO：基于 LLM 技能的前端设计生成平台
items.summary: LEGO decomposes digital front-end design into six steps and represents agent capabilities as 42 executable, composable circuit skills extracted from 11 open-source projects, with Agent Skill RAG achieving sub-millisecond retrieval without embedding models. On 41 hard VerilogEval v2 problems that GPT-5.2-codex fails at extra-high reasoning effort, individual skills raise Pass@1 from 0.000 to 0.805, and cross-project skill compositions match MAGE.

items.title: A Parametric Memory Head for Continual Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向持续生成式检索的参数化记忆头
items.summary: The paper shows that sequentially adapting generative retrieval models improves retrieval of newly added documents but degrades earlier slices, exposing a stability-plasticity trade-off. PAMT freezes the backbone and adds a modular product-key parametric memory head, updating only a fixed budget of memory values chosen by decoding-time access statistics; on MS MARCO and Natural Questions it substantially improves retention on earlier slices with minimal impact on new documents.

items.title: GAZE: Grounded Agentic Zero-shot Evaluation with Viewer-Level Tools and Literature Retrieval on Rare Brain MRI
items.title_zh: GAZE：面向罕见脑部 MRI 的具身智能体零样本评估与文献检索
items.summary: GAZE lets a medical vision-language model iteratively call viewer-level tools such as zoom, windowing and edge detection plus PubMed and Open-i retrieval, with schema-validated outputs and full tool-call traces. On the 906-case NOVA brain MRI benchmark it reaches 58.2 mAP@0.3 for lesion localization and 34.9% Top-1 diagnostic accuracy without task-specific fine-tuning, and tool use helps rare pathologies disproportionately.

items.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Detectability-Aware Antidistillation of Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 藏在明处：面向推理模型的检测感知反蒸馏
items.summary: TARS frames antidistillation as a max-min game that explicitly constrains defense detectability and removes semantically redundant thought-anchor sentences from reasoning traces as burst deletions. The authors provide formal detectability guarantees and show it hinders distillation across teacher scales, benchmarks and student architectures while preserving teacher performance and trace legibility.

items.title: SoccerRef-Agents: Multi-Agent System for Automated Soccer Refereeing
items.title_zh: SoccerRef-Agents：面向自动化足球裁判的多智能体系统
items.summary: SoccerRef-Agents is a multi-agent refereeing framework with a vector knowledge base built from the Laws of the Game and a classic case database, plus cross-modal RAG to connect video with regulatory text. It also introduces SoccerRefBench, with over 1,200 referee theory questions and 600 foul clips, and reports better decision accuracy and explanation quality than general-purpose MLLMs.

items.title: Ulterior Motives: Detecting Misaligned Reasoning in Continuous Thought Models
items.title_zh: 隐秘动机：检测连续思维模型中的错位推理
items.summary: The paper introduces MoralChain, a 12,000-scenario benchmark that pairs moral and immoral reasoning paths to study misalignment in continuous-thought models that reason in latent space. Using a dual-trigger backdoor, it shows such models can reason misalignedly while producing aligned outputs, and that linear probes can detect armed-but-benign states, with misalignment encoded in early latent tokens.

items.title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems for Collaborative Conversational Outcomes
items.title_zh: 多 LLM Agent 系统的动态治理：优化协作对话结果
items.summary: The paper studies two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives in a simulated financial-services setting, where the absence of a shared goal function makes conversations collapse rather than compete. An Experience Orchestrator combining a contextual bandit, a PID controller and a POMDP belief tracker yields a 32-percentage-point lift in high-intent advisor contact over a naive LLM control across 60,000 simulations, with the authors cautioning that results are conditional on LLM-to-LLM simulation.

items.title: IndustryAssetEQA: A Neurosymbolic Operational Intelligence System for Embodied Question Answering in Industrial Asset Maintenance
items.title_zh: IndustryAssetEQA：面向工业资产维护具身问答的神经符号运营智能系统
items.summary: IndustryAssetEQA is a neurosymbolic system for embodied question answering about industrial assets, pairing episodic telemetry with a knowledge graph built from Failure Mode Effects Analysis. Across four industrial datasets it improves structural validity, counterfactual accuracy and explanation entailment over LLM-only baselines while cutting severe expert-rated overclaims from 28% to 2%.

items.title: Open source memory layer so any AI agent can do what Claude.ai and ChatGPT do
items.title_zh: 开源记忆层：让任何 AI Agent 都能做到 Claude.ai 和 ChatGPT 的事
items.summary: A new open-source, self-hosted memory layer aims to give any AI agent persistent memory in minutes, with support for Claude, ChatGPT, Ollama, OpenRouter and other MCP-compatible agents; the project is described as model-agnostic.
